items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: George Lewis was playing with us. In Manneville. He used to play with us in Manneville.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Used to play down in the, in the, in the, the, the, not so long. He stayed there quite a while. He was good, he had a band and he left the other one long. George Lewis?
